verdicts.title: A weight-formula for all highest weight modules, and a higher order parabolic category $\mathcal{O}$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a complex Kac-Moody algebra, with Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak{h}$. Also fix a weight $λ\in\mathfrak{h}^*$. For $M(λ)\twoheadrightarrow V$ an arbitrary highest weight $\mathfrak{g}$-module, we provide a cancellation-free, non-recursive formula for the weights of $V$. verdicts.title: Proofs as Execution Trees for the π-Calculus
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
